book.name: Caque Coríntolachi
book.title: San Pablo Coríntolachi caque ereca jun pila

content: Junni epe diosi joe tinun moldechi tsachica epe cuwacaca payichinayoe. Weyan Jesucrístobe penenaminla jun tsachicaca fiminla joto, itsantiminlae: Chiquila jeralela tsara miramin joto, culpa ituto finiquiminlayoe latimanhe. Junni miranoca layan tennatuto, laquiranoca tenfenola joe. Mirayoe timinlari uyanlaca fe jochique tsantiminla joe. Laquiraminla mantimini uyanlaca fe jochique tenfetuminla joe; uyanlaca fe sonba tenca suwachique tenfeminla joe.
Tsaracari duque mirayoe timinlari ticanantiya seque camiitonla joe.
Diosica laquiraminlaca mantimini Diosi mirano joe yachi tsachila jolajoeque.

Junni epe diosi joe tinun moldechi tsachica epe cuwacaca tenca calaquisa! Ya tsachicaca fino munaraminla itsanlatichunae: Mancasiri Diosi joe latichunae. Junni epe diosi joe tinun molderi Diosi itolajoe latichunae. Junni tsachicaca yalachi cuwaca jonari, tichinantiya cuwaca itoe latichunae. Junto culpa ituto finiquintsan joe latichunae.
Tsa tilatinae. Jamochi o tote duque diosi joe tinunla joe. Duque miya joe tinunla joe.

Tsan josanan, chiquila yalaca tennatulajoyoe. Chiquilari miralarayoe mancasiri Diosi joeque Apa Diosi. Yari jera quica jonan, yachi tenchi sonnalarayoe. Junsi mancasiri Miyanan joe Jesucristo. Yari Apa Diosichi mantate jera quica jonan, yachi sonbabe sonnalarayoe.

Weyanla mantimini tsanque miitolajoe. Weyanlari epe diosi joe tinun moldelachi cale telenhimin jominlanue. Ya tsachilachi tencari ya epe diosi joe tinun moldela ya tsachica cuwacaca caminla joe. Ya tsachicaca ya tsan quiranlachi ica joeque tenca caminla joe. Junni tsanque cumana tenca joto, ya tsachicaca fitori, culpa iyoeque tenca cato, culpa patilaichunae.

Junni chiquilari ya tsachicaca finiquinari, ¿Diosi jun tenchi chiquilaca fe sen jolajoe tichunan? Te, tsantituchunae. Ya tsachicaca fitutori, fe seiton icaituchunae. O jun tsachicaca fitori, fe sen icaituchunae.
Junni tencabe nenalarana! Nulari pansile jun tsachicaca fino mantá tanilarayoe titori, cumana tenca tanlaca culpa patarilaquichunae.

Cumana tenca tanla nulaca quiralaquichunae. Epe diosi joe tinun moldechi yabi yachi tsachica cuwacaca finaminlaca quiralaquichunae. Junni nulaca quirato, miraminla joe tito, nula cuwenta finiquino tenca calaquichunae.

Junni yalanan ya tsachicaca fito, culpa iyoeque tenhito, culpa patilaichunae. Junni nula miraminla joyoe tinun tenchi yala yucapiyalaichunae. Nulachi acola jolajoe. Crístori yalachi tenchinan puyanue.
Nula tsanque nenalaratori, nulachi cumana tenca tan acolaca culpa patarilaquichunae. Junni yalaca tsanque seiton quinato, Crístocanan seiton quilaquinachunae.
Junni lachi acolari tsachica tenchi culpa iyoeque tenhinola jonari, la tsachicaca numanan manfituanae lachi acola yape culpa ilaitusa.
